subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] Input: add support for Goodix GTX8 Touchscreen ICs
author: Aelin Reidel
status: Submitted community driver; not present in pinned ACK 6.18
local_changes: Explicit required kernel headers and big-endian register addresses
Normandy slot ID masked as in official GT9886 and bounds checked for both families
Rate-limit touch checksum errors and log successful chip identification
Remove archive-obfuscated email from copyright and MODULE_AUTHOR, retain author attribution
firmware: Uses pre-flashed touch-controller firmware; no firmware/config flashing or factory Android binary is loaded
